problem: A data set has a standard deviation $\sigma =10.5$ and an unknown mean. An observation of the data set has the value $x=35.4$ and $z$-score $z=-1.1.$ Find the mean of the data set.

feedback.worked_solution:
To compute the value of an observation $x$ which yields a given $z$-score in a data set with mean $\overset{―}{x}$ and standard deviation $\sigma ,$ we can use the following formula:

$$
x=\overset{―}{x}+z\cdot \sigma 
$$

Substituting $\overset{―}{x}=-0.3,$ $z=1.4,$ and $\sigma =0.5$ into the formula and solving for $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\overset{―}{x}+z\cdot \sigma  \\ x & =-0.3+1.4\cdot 0.5 \\ x & =-0.3+0.7 \\ x & =0.4.\end{aligned}
$$
